comment: CASTING an Equipment from hand is not EQUIPPING the copy already in play. CheckLine used to fall back to matching an Equip action's card NAME inside the ordinary `cast=` multiset whenever the line declared no `equip=`, so this line -- 'cast the Bonesplitter in my hand' -- also matched the plans that only attach the Bonesplitter already on the battlefield. The user got a 'Choose how to resolve' dialog on a plain equipment cast and, picking wrong, would have left the card in hand (KittyEquipment seed 7 T3, 2026-09-01). Equip is now matched against spec.equips ALWAYS, in both directions: an empty spec.equips means 'this line performs no equip', so a plan that equips is not a match for it. One variant => accept => no dialog. The board deliberately holds BOTH copies (one in play, one in hand), which is the only arrangement where the two plays are expressible by the same token.
